courses.overview: 由取樣、量化、時鐘與高速介面延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend sampling, quantization, clocks and high-speed interfaces into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 高精度類比訊號調理
related.why: ADC 與訊號調理共同決定量測動態範圍。
related.whyEn: ADC and conditioning jointly determine measurement dynamic range.
related.transfer: ADC 與訊號調理共同決定量測動態範圍。
related.transferEn: ADC and conditioning jointly determine measurement dynamic range.
related.difference: 前端增益增加會改變 ADC 頭部空間，不能只提高放大倍數。
related.differenceEn: More front-end gain changes ADC headroom; gain cannot simply be maximized.
practice: 把「Nyquist 區帶」的概念圖與「高精度類比訊號調理」的輸入輸出對照。
畫出兩輸入腳的瞬時峰值而非只看差動幅度。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：前端增益增加會改變 ADC 頭部空間，不能只提高放大倍數。
practiceEn: Compare the nyquist zones concept map with inputs/outputs of Precision analog signal conditioning.
Plot instantaneous peaks at both input pins, not just differential amplitude.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: More front-end gain changes ADC headroom; gain cannot simply be maximized.

related.title: 鎖相迴路頻率合成器
related.why: 低抖動 PLL 是 ADC 時钟來源之一。
related.whyEn: A low-jitter PLL is one ADC clock source.
related.transfer: 低抖動 PLL 是 ADC 時钟來源之一。
related.transferEn: A low-jitter PLL is one ADC clock source.
related.difference: PLL 相噪積分範圍須與 ADC 使用條件對應。
related.differenceEn: PLL integration limits must match ADC use conditions.
practice: 把「解析度與範圍」的概念圖與「鎖相迴路頻率合成器」的輸入輸出對照。
掃描 RC 隔離網路與取樣窗，找殘餘誤差。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：PLL 相噪積分範圍須與 ADC 使用條件對應。
practiceEn: Compare the resolution and range concept map with inputs/outputs of Phase-locked-loop frequency synthesizers.
Sweep the isolating RC network and acquisition window to find residual error.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: PLL integration limits must match ADC use conditions.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Analog Devices 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。不同頻率可在取樣後映射到同一離散頻率。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「取樣、量化、時鐘與高速介面」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Analog Devices provides a traceable starting point. Different analog frequencies can map to the same sampled frequency. Independently authored models connect this to sampling, quantization, clocks and high-speed interfaces; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：孔徑延遲是平均時間偏移，孔徑抖動是取樣時間變動。 以「分開校正固定延遲和計算 RMS 時間變異。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: Aperture delay is mean timing offset; aperture jitter is sampling-time variation. Practice interpretation using: Correct fixed delay separately from computing RMS timing variation. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
